records.observation: JPanel vertical BoxLayout with etched border and static gap10. Constructor builds five labelled sections: zoomable reinitialization (root label, initial level, auto placement, screen and scroll ratios), all zoomable windows (root visibility, active refresh, background, state/nesting factors, antialias, min row/drag/click radius, instant zoom), timeline (real border/head/event dimensions, six preview display modes, preview border/insets/legend height/logbase, search marker), histogram (zero origin, summary border/logbase), legend (two sort booleans). Tooltips describe restart/redraw applicability, row-height lower bound, even arrow/event widths and approximate performance; these are descriptive strings, not enforced validation or measured performance. Text fields centered/editable with self document listeners, root label null STRING_FORMAT, initial depth ##0, other integer fields #,##0. All four float sliders created over 0..1, centered/editable, no panel self-document listener added to sliders. Boolean combos populated TRUE then FALSE, color five shared Const aliases, antialias three aliases. Real State border offers six styles excluding XOR; Preview and Summary include XOR plus six others. Preview display offers FitMostLegends, OverlapInclusionRatio, CumulativeInclusionRatio, OverlapExclusionRatio, CumulativeExclusionRatio, BaseAlignedCumulativeExclusionRatio. ACTIVE_REFRESH combo explicitly disabled after adding, but included in BOTH value-copy methods. Constructor does not load Parameters or register panel action listeners; normal PreferenceFrame separately calls updateAllFieldsFromParameters afterward, supplying document events for initially empty text fields. updateAllFieldsFromParameters sequentially copies all corresponding static settings using typed setters and object selection; it can quantize/clamp displayed float-slider values per existing slider/text receipt, does not write Parameters. updateAllParametersFromFields sequentially copies every field to corresponding static Parameters, using getText/getShort/getInteger/getFloat/getSelectedBooleanItem or casts Alias/StateBorder/String. No transaction, rollback, null/range/finite/evenness/logbase validation, enabled-state skip, exception handler, output file write, initStaticClasses, repaint or window restart in this class. Runtime failure leaves previous assignments; parse-error sentinels from LabeledTextField are accepted as values, partial numeric parse and narrowing also inherited. Float getFloat is inherited text parsing, not a forced slider position conversion: applying edits without slider action does not establish 0..1 bounds. Thus slider UI bounds do not prove parameter bounds; formatting can also change numerical round trips. Together with Frame and Parameters: Update/Save copies fields, Save then asks confirmation and writes, Close merely hides; no renderer propagation is directly issued by these dispatch/copy routines. Downstream code may apply changes later and remains caller evidence. Disabled active refresh is not a user-editable option in this panel, narrowing prior persistence finding to externally/currently set true values. No archived GUI execution or independent semantic approval.
